definition: two real runs of the same task: one normal run (context fetchers, compact returns, history compaction) and one --baseline run (context fetchers and compaction disabled; baselineDefinition of its token report). Both numbers are what each run counted for the requests it actually sent.

explanations.reduction_pct: per-run totals: 1 - (input tokens summed over every turn of the normal run) / (the same sum for the --baseline run). It depends on how many turns each run took, so it mixes context size with the path each run took.
explanations.per_turn_reduction_pct: per-turn average: 1 - (normal run's input tokens per turn) / (--baseline run's input tokens per turn), each run's total divided by its own turn count. Independent of the turn counts: the closer measure of context size per request when the runs took different paths.
explanations.provider_reported_reduction_pct: the per-run-totals ratio over the input tokens the provider reported; null when either run has no provider-reported usage (an offline driver).
explanations.jit_shadow_reduction_pct: the normal run's own shadow estimate (its token report), shown for reference: an estimate from one trajectory, never sent.

caveats: turn counts differ (60 vs 16): the runs took different paths; reduction_pct (per-run totals) reflects that, per_turn_reduction_pct (per-turn averages) does not
